tools.description: Make a QR code image without an account or key, saving nothing. tools.description: List the account's codes, newest first, with each one's id, name, folder, kind (changeable or static), what it holds or where it points, short link, status and all-time scans. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_account · Private data: get_code, download_code, create_code, update_code · Public sink: create_static_code, get_account, create_code, update_code.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_account · Private data: get_code, download_code, create_code, update_code · Public sink: create_static_code, get_account, create_code, update_code

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
